title: Semantic adapter interface callback overload inventory
scope: Repair the semantic-adapter builder's current DRW_Interface inventory self-test failure
Explicitly recognize only reviewed ownership-transfer overloads
Keep adapter callback coverage name-based while rejecting unreviewed overload declarations

details: The inventory parser now accepts the exact const-reference/rvalue-reference overload pairs for addDataStorage, addModelerGeometry, and addUnsupportedObject.

The callback-name inventory remains unique for adapter coverage; overload signatures are separately checked against an explicit allowlist so additive API overloads cannot silently disappear into the name-only digest.
Builder self-tests now reject an arbitrary overloaded callback, an added third addDataStorage overload, and a duplicated declaration of an allowed overload.

limitations: This closes only the current source-inventory parser mismatch and its fast self-test boundary. It does not complete the 7AG.4 effective compiler/SDK/runtime contract, 7F.1b typed result migration, native GNU/MSVC qualification, semantic qualification, or any DWG/DXF support claim.
workingTree: The shared worktree is broadly modified. This slice remains unstaged and uncommitted; unrelated edits were preserved.
